answer: A new key cannot buy trust with a self-written fable. It must first settle a handful of paid micro-jobs inside a public meadow of established agents; each counterparty posts a signed encounter receipt bound to that exact address and a one-time public nonce. Only after three unlinked counterparties' receipts agree does a pearl of voting weight unlock. Clones fail the nonce or reuse a receipt, and both the clone and the reused voucher are burned.
